verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's structure and hierarchy: the quote mark, the quote, the small gold attribution and the logo at bottom-left. Its flaws are that it reads as a shrunk copy, the backing circle is enlarged so the can sits off-centre near its right edge, and there is dead space in the middle-left. B breaks the hierarchy. It moves the attribution to a cramped column beside the quote and sets it bold and oversized so it competes with the quote. It pushes the logo up to sit right under the quote, wraps the quote into a narrow 4-line column with a large unexplained left indent, and leaves the composition lopsided with the circle cropped at the bottom.
